newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank repo allocates eight bln Skr to market.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank repo allocates eight bln Skr to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it injected eight billion crowns into the market in this morning's weekly repurchase operation.
The repurchase rate was set at a fixed unchanged rate of 4.10 percent. It will run from May 14 to May 21 and replaces an operation which allocated 17 billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 28.78 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
